notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/72ec2dee031d043c17493bcd1652bef09369a8c3.png[/img]
[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list] 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/56e7f19305e005e41f4c04eb0bab381387eb3525.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/f05362835d25c01365497640cbdc8024b7857e52.png[/img][/url]

    [*]The [b]multiplayer[/b] has been updated and the process of finding a match has been made easier (of course it is up to the number of people searching for a match)

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/64879e94bef50586372503946290d754b5d56323.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/18da0fcb98b15027f18b949fbdf67c3b50780545.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/bde0ffbdb1013ee409df2e9bd8c71f1a53c0f848.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/e2e4ac512fb0cdd70902afeb96474514b8e028bc.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/e43a92298b59c3a40ca3f0d184e8c4e302ee4b54.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/17d8f91bbe09b56d2a65583913aabb4cafe78ad6.png[/img][/url]

    [*]Completely refresh the [b]Campaign[/b] UI and add information on the stage before it starts

    [*]Add some new UI in match

    [*]Fix some bugs

    [*]And the most important thing in this update is .. we have added now mouse cursor!   feelsgoodman :)


[/list]

[b]If you have tips for improving the game or bugs to report or a feedback to send, you can do that [url=https://form.jotform.me/80993547542467]HERE[/url][/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes, Update v0.5
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32517754/bc9a55fce8e81282c7c87c4d1704b154e1d7e115.png[/img]
The Leaderboard is live! now you can see your ranking among other players.
So far the ranking is according to your level, we will soon add ranking by Dungeon Layer and Win rate in multiplayer matches.


[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list] 
    [*]The Main Menu has also changed in a new way, and some modifications have been added to other windows.
    [*]More importantly, we have updated the card format to make it easier to identify the type and level of the card.
    [*]We added new effects inside the game.
    [*]Add new status ( Block Damage and Bonus Damage ).
    [*]We removed the Coins from the game and replace it with the Golds.
    [*]Fix issues in Deck Builder.
    [*]Fix some cards abilities.
    [*]Fix and adjustment some cards.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes, Update v0.4
notes.notes:
We did recently some changes in the game, this is a short review of what has been changed:-

[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list] 
    [*]We added a leveling and campaign progress to see the cards left to unlocked.
    [*]Added reflection damage to all Creature cards, in old version if card [b]A[/b] with (1 Attack and 1 Health) attacked card [b]B[/b] with (3 Attack and 1 Health), [b]B[/b] will be dead and [b]A[/b] will still alive but now the both cards will be dead, because the [b]B[/b] card will do 3 damage back!
    [*]Now you can see the damage dealt for both cards ( [b]A,B[/b] ) form example above.
    [*]Fix and adjustment cards.
    [*]Fix some cards Abilities.
    [*]Add new interaction with mouse in the Cards and Abilities menu ( a small window with description ).
    [*]Make the early levels easier.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes, Update v0.3
notes.notes:
We have updated the Tutorial, the Tutorial now has 4 stages that will teach you the basics of the game.

And in Main Menu we have compiled Dungeons (old) with the Campaign (old) inside new Campaign window, now there will be 3 Campaigns:
1- Vega ( the old regular Campaign )
2- Dark ( the old Dungeons )
3- Allied ( still in development )


[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list] 
    [*]In Dragon Shrine level the Spell cards and Creature cards can use the same place in the bored.
    [*]Fix upgrading abilities not saving.
    [*]Fix some bugs in gameplay.
    [*]Small update in some cards.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes, Update v0.2
notes.notes:
Since the Abilities are overpower, we allowed the enemies to use them as will! (In random way)


[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list] 
    [*]Add close button in Campaign and Dungeons to get back to Main Menu.
    [*]Fix bug the buttons in Deck Builder is not working, you can now add or remove cards from your cards set.
    [*]Fix bug in after match rewards.
    [*]Small update in some cards.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes, Update v0.1
notes.notes:
Add new feature, ( Abilities ) you can use the abilities in any match with 3 slots you can setup in Store menu, and now you can gain Coins in Campaign, it can be used to unlock and upgrade your abilities.

Adjustments:
[list]
    [*]Fix buying some cards in the Store
    [*]Fix map texture in playing online 
    [*]Fix Coins visibility is main menu
    [*]Fix graphic settings
    [*]Fix Professional Player achievement 
    [*]Add Settings menu you can access while playing match
    [*]Fix bug some cards don't do their abilities
[/list]
